metadata.title: From Fold to Physics: An Exact, Parameter-Free and Machine-Closed Reconstruction of Physical Science from Smithian Fold Theory
metadata.description:
From Fold to Physics, version 1.1 is the corrected and expanded standalone paper for the completed categorical Physics branch of the third clean-room reconstruction of Smithian Fold Theory (SFT). It covers all 285 claims whose registration and immutable model-admitted receipt assign them to Physics. Cross-disciplinary V1/V2 observations are no longer bulk-labelled as Physics.

The release preserves 172,016 explicitly generated candidates, 172,016 one-for-one decisions, 285 unique survivors and 1,140 passing adverse controls. Candidate grammars use their actual declared cardinalities rather than one repeated template. All 285 derivations are documented with root dependencies, exact theorem statements, candidate generators, closure boundaries, survivor identities, local uniqueness witnesses, controls, independent reconstruction hashes, empirical custody where registered and engine receipts.

Headline results include generator three, three-dimensional Fold stability, rank-two boundary support, inverse-square dilution, the terminal exact inverse fine-structure relation and its post-seal CODATA comparison, physical constants and scale relations, vacuum structure and extraction limits, complete force sectors, quantum and relativistic correspondence, matter and flavour, atomic and molecular precision successors, nuclear and hadronic structure, gravitational exterior and radiated-power laws, and the strong self-source fixed-point boundary.

The derivational domain admits empty One as structural absence but excludes numerical zero, negative proof magnitudes, irrational and imaginary proof values, binary floating proof arithmetic, completed infinity, ungenerated continua, axioms, free parameters and fitted coefficients. External measurements test sealed consequences and cannot select a law. The PDF is uploaded first for Zenodo preview, followed by the canonical Markdown paper and reproducibility archive.
metadata.notes: Copyright 2026 Maria Smith. Paper and documentation: CC BY 4.0. Repository code: Apache-2.0. Ernos Labs is a separate scientific-standards conformance designation. Version 1.1 corrects branch bookkeeping and expands the paper from the original 132-law inventory to every one of the 285 currently engine-admitted categorical Physics claims; it does not rewrite any derivation receipt or alter the admission engine. Chemistry, Materials, Biology, Consciousness, astronomical history and applications are not counted as Physics.
